{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate: keep only the row with the highest sample_seq per patient_id
deduplicated_data = data.loc[data.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Filter for control arm and moderate severity
treatment_group = deduplicated_data[(deduplicated_data['arm'] == 'control') & (deduplicated_data['severity'] == 'moderate')]

# Compute the fraction of responders
num_responders = treatment_group['responded'].sum()
total_patients = len(treatment_group)
fraction_responded = num_responders / total_patients

# Print results
print("Number of control-arm patients with moderate severity after deduplication:", total_patients)
print("Number of responders among them:", num_responders)
print("Fraction responded:", fraction_responded)"}
